announcement.title: 🐦 Chirp App v2.0.0
announcement.content:
Chirp App v2.0.0 lets players use Chirp without a connected GM while the Foundry world stays running.

  • Create an account, sign in, publish posts and replies, react, follow accounts, edit profiles, read notifications, and send direct messages.
  • Activity persists after reconnecting, and simultaneous updates preserve each player's changes.
  • Incoming activity preserves drafts and scroll position. New direct messages appear unread even when in-game time is paused.

GM account management and moderation still require a GM.
